say:2:1710714001:1.text: Whoa! These two look exactly the same!
say:2:1710714001:1.source_cn: 哇！这两柄石中剑看起来简直一模一样！

say:3:1710714002:1.text: They do. From the holy aura to the grooves along the base... not a single detail is off.
say:3:1710714002:1.source_cn: 确实……从圣光的光晕，到底座延伸的轨迹……几乎分毫不差。

say:4:1710714003:1.text: If Magister Merlin hadn't found the real one, maybe only Dura herself could tell them apart.
say:4:1710714003:1.source_cn: 如果不是梅林大人他们找到真正的石中剑，或许只有艾雅女神...
say:4:1710714003:1.male: If Magister Merlin hadn't found the real one, maybe only Dura herself could tell them apart.
say:4:1710714003:1.female: If Magister Merlin hadn't found the real one, maybe only Dura herself could tell them apart.

say:5:1710714004:1.text: ... Why do you think my brother would do something like this?
say:5:1710714004:1.source_cn: ……科丝蒂，你说，哥哥他为什么要这么做呢？

say:6:1710714005:1.text: Your Highness... I... I can only speak from what I've read...
say:6:1710714005:1.source_cn: 殿下，我……我只是从书上读到过……

say:7:1710714006:1.text: Throughout any kingdom's history, forging a symbol of succession usually points to one thing.
say:7:1710714006:1.source_cn: 无论是哪一国的王权历史，伪造继承信物，通常都……都只有...

say:9:1710714008:1.source_cn: 那就是，当事人对此没有信心。

say:10:1710714009:1.text: If I had to guess... maybe Prince Orion was afraid he couldn't pull Excalibur.
say:10:1710714009:1.source_cn: 从理论上推断，王子殿下他……也许是担心自己，无法拔出真...

say:11:1710714010:1.text: How could that be? He's the eldest son. Everyone knows he's next. He's the brother I admire, the one who always shines so brightly!
say:11:1710714010:1.source_cn: 怎么会？他是父王的长子，是公认的继承人啊！是我非常敬佩...

say:12:1710714011:1.text: *Sigh* Maybe Merlin's right. He must've lost his way...
say:12:1710714011:1.source_cn: ……唉，或许就像梅林他们说的，他一定是误入歧途，脑子不...
say:12:1710714011:1.male: *Sigh* Maybe Merlin's right. He must've lost his way...
say:12:1710714011:1.female: *Sigh* Maybe Merlin's right. He must've lost his way...

say:13:1710714012:1.text: Court struggles are far more tangled than any ancient history I studied at the academy...
say:13:1710714012:1.source_cn: 这些宫廷的纷争，比我在学院里读过的任何古代史都复杂难解……

say:14:1710714013:1.text: Let's fulfill Her Majesty's request first.
say:14:1710714013:1.source_cn: 殿下，我们还是先完成王后陛下的嘱托吧。

say:16:1710714015:1.text: Whatever his reasons, our job now is clear. Swap the swords and stop him before he makes things worse!
say:16:1710714015:1.source_cn: 不管他为什么要这么做，我们现在的任务，就是把这柄伪剑换...
